title: Quasi-Monte Carlo with a Hankel random digital net
summary: This paper proposes a new randomized design of digital nets in which the generating matrices are chosen to be random Hankel matrices. Compared with previous randomized designs of digital nets, this approach simplifies the construction process and reduces the number of random variables required, while still achieving desirable convergence rates when combined with appropriate estimators.
